title: On Learning Spatial Structure from Pre-Beamforming Per-Antenna Range-Doppler Radar Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2604.01921v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automotive radar perception pipelines commonly construct angle-domain representations via beamforming before applying learning-based models. This work instead investigates a representational question: can meaningful spatial structure be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna range-Doppler (RD) measurements? Experiments are conducted on a 6-TX x 8-RX (48 virtual antennas) commodity automotive radar employing an A/B chirp-sequence frequency-modulated continuous-wave (CS-FMCW) transmit scheme, in which the effective transmit aperture varies between chirps (single-TX vs multi-TX), enabling controlled analyses of chirp-dependent transmit configurations. We operate on pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors using a dual-chirp shared-weight encoder trained in an end-to-end, fully data-driven manner, and evaluate spatial recoverability using bird's-eye-view (BEV) occupancy as a geometric probe rather than a performance-driven

translated_title: 关于从波束形成前的每天线距离-多普勒雷达测量中学习空间结构的研究
translated_abstract: 汽车雷达感知流水线通常在应用基于学习的模型之前，先通过波束形成构建角度域表示。本工作转而研究一个表示性问题：能否直接从波束形成前的每天线距离-多普勒（RD）测量中学习到有意义的空间结构？实验在一台6发射×8接收（48个虚拟天线）的商用汽车雷达上进行，该雷达采用A/B啁啾序列调频连续波（CS-FMCW）发射方案，其有效发射孔径在不同啁啾之间变化（单发射与多发射），从而能够对依赖啁啾的发射配置进行受控分析。我们直接在波束形成前的每天线RD张量上进行操作，使用双啁啾共享权重编码器以端到端、完全数据驱动的方式进行训练，并以鸟瞰图（BEV）占用作为几何探针而非性能驱动指标来评估空间结构的可恢复性。
tldr: 该论文提出用双啁啾共享权重编码器端到端地直接从波束形成前的每天线距离-多普勒雷达张量中学习空间结构，并以鸟瞰图占用作为几何探针验证了空间信息的可恢复性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that meaningful spatial structure can be learned end-to-end directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna range-Doppler radar tensors using a dual-chirp shared-weight encoder, with bird's-eye-view occupancy serving as a geometric probe to evaluate spatial recoverability.
